note: Lean's `Spent` carries the forced (normalized) terms through the second field `gas` with the weight `κ`; the graph norm with its column constant and the eligibility events are not separately stated.

snippet.text:
structure Spent (ok : R.Mode → Prop) (A : Bands R P) (w : V → ℝ) (δ κ c : ℝ) : Prop where
  exponent : ∃ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) ∧ (∀ i, ok (A.rays i) → ∀ v∈ (A.rays i).val,
    P.p.supBounds (A.origins v) (A.support i) (A.H i) (a i)) ∧ Weighted A.rays A.support P.p w δ a c
  gas : ∃ b : ℕ × ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) ∧ (∀ i, ok (tags A i) → ∀ U, ‖A.entries i.1 i.2 U‖ ≤ b i) ∧
    Weighted (tags A) (forced P) P.p w δ b (κ*c)

proof_context.conclusion: `Spent` has an exponent part for supports and a `gas` part bounding the forced entries `A.entries` with the `forced` supports and budget `κ*c`.
